name: How much does professional window weatherproofing typically cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does professional window weatherproofing typically cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional window weatherproofing in the Bay Area varies significantly based on the number of windows, their size, the chosen materials, and the extent of work required. Basic services like re-caulking and weatherstripping might range from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars for an average home. More extensive projects, such as installing storm windows or repairing significant frame damage prior to sealing, will naturally incur higher costs. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
